page.layout: One page of running text in one column, right of centre. Margin notes in the left margin: a three-line Latin note beside "recensa", and a three-line black-letter German note beside "habet". Page number and running head at the top left. No catchword or signature.
page.running_head: De Agro Fris. inter Lavic. & Amas:

main_text.p: amnis, ubi Delfsilæus portus & castellum, milliare dimidium: vallo, fossa, portis quondam munita ab Edsardo ante annos centum, & triennio post à Georgio Saxone civitatis quoque jure atque ordine magistratuum donata; sed his ab eodem post annos xii, illis à Geldro anno sequente rursus exuta nudataque: à Tautenburgio demum Burgundiæ militiæ duce anno M. D. xxxv i excidio damnata, & vix precibus suorum incolumis conservata. Ipsa caput quondam Fivelgoniæ: à cujus Ordinibus jura ejus qualiacunque ac statuta vetera, per manus accepta, & in more posita, quæ privilegia sua Dammonenses vocant, solenni in conventu, anno post Natalem Christi M. CCC.XXVII Litere de iureDam-monesium, vulgodicta recensa probataque, & mox paucos post dies ab omnibus quoque Frisiis in comitiis universægentis ad Vpstallesbomum confirmata esse, in Historia exposui. In statutis his hæc reperio, Dammonam, ut nunc De Buer / Vzieff bā / den Dā. habet, ita tunc habuisse judices suos ex indigenis lectos: his finito muneris sui tempore (triennè id esse solet) cum primario loci sacerdote jus fuisse, die xxii Februarij fuc-cessores

page.notes: The left-margin notes are partly worn. The first reads "Litere de iureDam-monesium, vulgodicta" and the second is black letter; the second note's first word "De Buer" and its middle line "Vzieff bā" are doubtful and could be misread. The final word "cessores" is set in italic and is partly hidden by the page edge, so the completion of "fuc-" is uncertain; it may read "successores" in full. The digitiser's "Digitized by Google" mark at lower right is omitted.
